title: Federal learning gradient attack defense method based on joint differential privacy
assignee: Yunnan Vocational Institute Of Energy Technology

pse.problem: Gradient attacks on multi-classification tasks in federated learning scenarios
pse.solution_function: Defends against gradient attacks by clipping micro-batch gradients, adding Gaussian noise to clipped gradients, and updating the global model parameters in a differential privacy manner.
pse.solution_structure: System model parameters (initial learning rate, privacy parameter, gradient sensitivity threshold, Gaussian noise standard deviation factor), mini-batches, micro-batches, participants
pse.solution_implementation:
Step 1: Initialize system model parameters
Step 2: Randomly select participants and calculate micro-batch gradients
Step 3: Perform threshold-limited clipping on micro-batch gradients
Step 4: Add Gaussian noise to clipped gradient vectors
Step 5: Calculate gradient parameter loss and update global model parameters in a differential privacy manner
pse.effect: Enhanced privacy protection for federated learning participants while maintaining accuracy of model classification tasks
